text:
Ivy: quick morning mystery  why did the release job scream when i pushed a doc update? :scream:
Samir: did the doc contain prophetic semver? :crystal_ball:
Ivy: this tiny snippet was the culprit:
Ivy: ```yaml
version: v2..0
notes:
	- updated API samples
```
Ivy: two dots + tabbed list. the parser took one look and ghosted the repo.
lint-bot: Commit rejected: YAMLLintError (line 1): Invalid version string 'v2..0' ; Tabs detected in YAML. See rules: https://ci.internal/yaml-rules
Rashida: classic. the parser only accepts committed sincerity and well-formed semver.
Samir: proposed livepatch: auto-fix `v2..0` -> `v2.0.0` and convert tabs -> two spaces. optional shame note in commit message.
Ivy: i prefer the shame note. it doubles as a release note. :eyes:
lint-bot: Suggested automated fix available: https://ci.internal/auto-fix/7421 
Ivy: clicking the link... apply fix pls.
lint-bot: Automated commit applied by CI: "fix(yaml): normalize semver v2..0 -> v2.0.0 and replace tabs" (CI #7421)
Samir: glorious. also we should add a tiny pre-commit that rejects versions like `v1.0-alpha` unless they come with an artist statement.
Rashida: agree. new team rule: semver must be three numbers. if not, you owe the team one haiku and a coffee.
Ivy: haiku challenge accepted. here's my draft:
Ivy: "dots like falling stars
I pressed save, the parser cried
coffee buys forgiveness" :coffee:
Samir: perfection. i'll add the hook and a failing test that outputs the haiku on error.
Rashida: and stickers: "I survived YAML and only had 2 dots."
Ivy: PR opened: https://ci.internal/prs/8420 - adds semver regex and whitespace fixer.
lint-bot: CI #7421 redeployed docs  staging ok :sparkles:
Samir: thanks for the catch, Ivy. your doc will live to confuse humans another day. :grin:
Ivy: thanks team. also note: tab authors will be judged by a panel of senior developers.
